The '''Spectrader Ring''' was a criminal gang that operated on at least thirty [[Planet/Legends|planets]]. At one time, it was led by [[Andews Rolo]], until he was incarcerated on the [[Prison/Legends|prison]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Captivity]]. A [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] keep him alive as an incentive to hold over the new leaders of the Spectrader Ring.
